commands.sentinel: same reference command with the separately built instrumented checker

logs: Published text transcripts strip ANSI display codes and trailing whitespace; original logs remain in the local evidence directory. Timing records and CSVs are unmodified.
retained_nonfinal_trials: Probes and first confirmation are retained separately. Final confirmation uses the final production build. Earlier diagnostic canaries were not pooled with final measurements; the final canary block ran without overlapping analysis/build/test work.

stan_math.scope: Zero the adjoint ODE backward quadrature output before accumulation. Predates this optimization; COM-Poisson does not use ODEs. No dependency edits in this change.

source_patch_storage: source.patch.gz; source_patch_sha256 hashes the uncompressed bytes
